notes.title: Ver. 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Update Contents[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
- Added keyboard keys to open various windows
You can check the current key assignments in the key bindings of the options window. The corresponding windows are as follows.
    - Dice setting window
    - Art size setting window
    - Image window
    - Help window
    - Options window
*These keys cannot be used on the title screen.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Update Contents[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Changed to display dice number images more clearly

[h3]Additions[/h3]
- Added the ability to change the number and background colors of the dice number images
(Dice number images already generated in ver.1.0.0 do not support this function, so please load the same image or invert the image using the invert function and regenerate it.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45316082/601bcaa1c267c9880661a4c9f1b5c1869d216475.png[/img]

- Added a News window to the title screen

- Added zoom in and zoom out to the operation guide

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where input was not accepted when using a gamepad to press the dice color change button to display the cursor and press the confirm button on the color panel

notes.title: Dice Art Studio is out now!
notes.notes:
Today, I released Dice Art Studio!
I hope you enjoy making dice art!

I am currently developing version 1.1. In version 1.1, I plan to add new features and mini-games.

Please check the community thread for bug reports and requests.
I will continue to update the app and improve your game experience.

[b]Have a great dice art life![/b]

notes.title: Create a dice art. Utagawa Hiroshige "Jumantsubo Plain at Fukagawa Susaki"
notes.notes:
[h2]I bring you a look at Dice Art Studio's gameplay![/h2]

[h2]This time's topic[/h2]
Utagawa Hiroshige "Jumantsubo Plain at Fukagawa Susaki, from the Series One Hundred Scenic Spots of Edo"

Using the in-game function, create dice art using the dice number image converted from the original image as a reference.

Utagawa Hiroshige《Jumantsubo Plain at Fukagawa Susaki, from the Series One Hundred Scenic Spots of Edo》Tokyo Fuji Art Museum Collection Included in Tokyo Fuji Art Museum Collection Database （https://www.fujibi.or.jp/en/collection/artwork/10184/）
